manifest.source: Speech Commands v0.02 (download.tensorflow.org) and ESC-50 (github.com/karoldvl/ESC-50); log-mel spectrogram images, ResNet-18 ImageNet embeddings; attacks applied to raw 16 kHz waveforms
manifest.policy: Tune only on the dev split (Speech Commands validation speakers, ESC-50 folds 1-3); the test split (testing speakers, folds 4-5) is the headline. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change.
